```{python}
from pathlib import Path


def find_project_root(start):
    path = Path(start).resolve()
    for candidate in (path, *path.parents):
        if (candidate / ".unaltraweb" / "computations.yml").is_file():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")


width = 1240
height = 680
left_points = [
    (165, 285, "P1"),
    (270, 285, "P2"),
    (220, 380, "P3"),
    (430, 430, "P4"),
]
right_points = [(x + 690, y, label) for x, y, label in left_points]

svg = [
    f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">',
    '  <title id="title">Comparació entre buffers individuals i una cobertura dissolta</title>',
    '  <desc id="desc">Quatre punts generen buffers. A l’esquerra es mantenen quatre entitats i els solapaments; a la dreta se’n dissolen les fronteres internes, de manera que queda una entitat multipart amb dos components i es perd l’atribució directa a cada punt.</desc>',
    '  <defs>',
    '    <style>',
    "      .bg { fill: #f5f7f8; }",
    "      .card { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #c8d3d9; stroke-width: 2; }",
    "      text { font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; }",
    "      .title { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700; fill: #17202a; }",
    "      .subtitle { font-size: 22px; fill: #52616b; }",
    "      .heading { font-size: 27px; font-weight: 700; fill: #17202a; }",
    "      .body { font-size: 22px; fill: #33434c; }",
    "      .label { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; fill: #33434c; }",
    "      .individual { fill: #7fc4de; fill-opacity: .38; stroke: #2878a5; stroke-width: 3; }",
    "      .dissolved { fill: #7fc4de; }",
    "      .point { fill: #d65f43; stroke: #8c3225; stroke-width: 2.5; }",
    "      .chip { fill: #e6f1f6; stroke: #8eb9cc; stroke-width: 1.5; }",
    "      .warning { fill: #f7e8d2; stroke: #d5a768; stroke-width: 1.5; }",
    '    </style>',
    '    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="11" markerHeight="11" refX="8" refY="3.5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">',
    '      <path d="M0,0 L0,7 L9,3.5 z" fill="#52616b"/>',
    '    </marker>',
    '    <filter id="union-outline" x="-15%" y="-15%" width="130%" height="130%">',
    '      <feMorphology in="SourceAlpha" operator="dilate" radius="3" result="expanded"/>',
    '      <feFlood flood-color="#2878a5" result="outline-color"/>',
    '      <feComposite in="outline-color" in2="expanded" operator="in" result="outline"/>',
    '      <feMerge>',
    '        <feMergeNode in="outline"/>',
    '        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>',
    '      </feMerge>',
    '    </filter>',
    '  </defs>',
    f'  <rect class="bg" width="{width}" height="{height}"/>',
    '  <text x="35" y="46" class="title">Conservar l’origen o mesurar la cobertura única?</text>',
    '  <text x="35" y="77" class="subtitle">Dissoldre respon una pregunta diferent; no és una neteja automàtica que serveixi per a qualsevol anàlisi.</text>',
    '  <rect x="35" y="105" width="500" height="510" rx="12" class="card"/>',
    '  <text x="65" y="148" class="heading">Buffers individuals</text>',
    '  <text x="65" y="179" class="subtitle">Una geometria per cada punt generador</text>',
]

for x, y, label in left_points:
    svg.extend([
        f'  <circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="76" class="individual"/>',
        f'  <circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="8" class="point"/>',
        f'  <text x="{x + 12}" y="{y - 12}" class="label">{label}</text>',
    ])

svg.extend([
    '  <rect x="65" y="510" width="440" height="36" rx="18" class="chip"/>',
    '  <text x="285" y="536" text-anchor="middle" class="label">4 entitats · origen identificable</text>',
    '  <rect x="65" y="558" width="440" height="36" rx="18" class="warning"/>',
    '  <text x="285" y="584" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Solapament · doble recompte</text>',
    '  <line x1="565" y1="345" x2="660" y2="345" stroke="#52616b" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>',
    '  <text x="612" y="325" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Dissoldre</text>',
    '  <rect x="705" y="105" width="500" height="510" rx="12" class="card"/>',
    '  <text x="735" y="148" class="heading">Cobertura dissolta</text>',
    '  <text x="735" y="179" class="subtitle">Les fronteres internes desapareixen</text>',
    '  <g filter="url(#union-outline)">',
])

for x, y, _ in right_points:
    svg.append(f'    <circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="76" class="dissolved"/>')

svg.append('  </g>')
for x, y, label in right_points:
    svg.extend([
        f'  <circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="8" class="point"/>',
        f'  <text x="{x + 12}" y="{y - 12}" class="label">{label}</text>',
    ])

svg.extend([
    '  <rect x="735" y="510" width="440" height="36" rx="18" class="chip"/>',
    '  <text x="955" y="536" text-anchor="middle" class="label">1 entitat multipart · 2 components</text>',
    '  <rect x="735" y="558" width="440" height="36" rx="18" class="warning"/>',
    '  <text x="955" y="584" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Cobertura única · origen perdut</text>',
    '  <text x="620" y="655" text-anchor="middle" class="subtitle">Convé conservar les dues sortides quan calen atribució per origen i superfície conjunta.</text>',
    '</svg>',
])

project_root = find_project_root(Path.cwd())
output = project_root / "assets/img/generated/06-analisi-geoprocessament-vectorial/buffer-dissolve.svg"
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text("\n".join(svg) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
```
